data.title: 黑馆晴奈 · 宴会露台的深红旗袍风姿
data.description: 美食研究会顶级晚宴的露天观景台上，微风带来初秋的凉意。晴奈身穿一袭紧身高开衩深红金丝旗袍，完美的黄金身材比例被旗袍剪裁展现得淋漓尽致。单侧黑色蝙蝠形翼在月光下泛着幽蓝光泽，她单手倚在石栏旁轻托香腮，红唇微抿，回眸望来的神态高贵凌厉，却又在四目相对的瞬间融化为唯你独享的专注目光。
data.action: standing gracefully by stone terrace railing in fitted red high-slit qipao, a single black demon wing catching moonlight, chin resting on palm, captivating regal smirk
data.location: classical banquet terrace under luminous full moon
data.lighting: brilliant silver moonlight illuminating a dark wing and crimson satin
data.mood: aristocratic predatory grace, breathtaking gourmet devotion
data.promptProse: Standing by a classical stone balustrade beneath a full moon, Kurodate Haruna poses in a fitted crimson cheongsam with a high leg slit. Her single black wing shimmers in moonlight as she smiles with dangerous, aristocratic elegance.
data.animaCaption: Haruna on a moonlit terrace in a red high-slit qipao, a single black wing glistening under the moon.
